query: The landing page headline in landing.css shouts. Tone it down so it still reads as the main heading on phones and desktops.
Our blog posts feel like one long grey slab. Give templates/blog-post.html and prose.css some structure people can scan.
Make the plan prices in index.html line up in their column.
Customers zoom the site to 200% and the hero text barely grows. Sort out the sizes in landing.css.
The feature text under each heading is hard to read on a laptop. Fix landing.css.
Get the invoice template ready for Finnish customers: dates, euro amounts and VAT numbers shown the way they expect.
Set the body text in main.css so it is comfortable to read for long help articles.
Code blocks and inline code in our docs look out of place next to the body text. Adjust the styles.
We are adding a Japanese docs section. What should change in prose.css?
The changelog headings are barely different from the entries. Give changelog.css a clear hierarchy.
Add a build step to package.json that minifies main.css and landing.css.
Make the .sidebar in main.css stack under the content below 700px.
Write a unit test for src/utils/formatDate.js covering the Finnish locale.
Replace the link colour in main.css with our new brand blue #0b5fff and add a hover state.
Add Open Graph meta tags to index.html.
